articles.title: Burnham says he is prepared to call out Trump 'if right for Britain'
articles.description: Speaking exclusively to the BBC, the prime minister says he had a good first conversation with the US president and insists "you have to defend your own national interest".

articles.title: Andy Burnham rules out early election in exclusive BBC interview
articles.description: The new prime minister told Laura Kuenssberg that people "voted for a manifesto" that he would honour, when pressed on whether there will be an early general election.

articles.title: France battles fire 'whirlwinds' as another 55,000 evacuated
articles.description: More than 340,000 people have now been evacuated from wildfires in France and Spain.

articles.title: What Love Island tells us about the changing face of dating
articles.description: From women making the first move to shifting relationship dynamics, Love Island has become a window into Britain's evolving dating culture
